stageA.sourceMathematics: Compose large shapes from two, three or four equal-size pattern blocks; composite perimeter depends on arrangement and shared edges, so counts of component sides alone do not determine outer sides.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original Activity1 asks to form THREE different shapes using equal-size blocks, trace their outlines on source GRID and name each composition. Example:2 trapezoids form a hexagon;4 small squares form a larger square.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher evaluates actual spatial composition, correct traced outer outline, equal-size component blocks and naming.
